svg.title: LLM development
svg.desc: Coding agents, custom harnesses, and local models. I use Codex and Claude Code for repository exploration, implementation, debugging, and review. Taskflow Local and Sandman connect models to structured outputs, validation, and tool access. Their execution loops cover local inference, agent orchestration, retries, and cleanup. Pipeline: context → model → tools → validation → review.

g.text: Coding agents, custom harnesses, and local models.
I use Codex and Claude Code for repository exploration, implementation, debugging, and review.

Their execution loops cover local inference, agent orchestration, retries, and cleanup.
